spec.description: Chatmail notifications: delivery failures and token cleanup. See https://github.com/chatmail/notifiers

spec.title: Notification delivery failures
spec.description: Real delivery failures per hour, grouped by provider, reason, and detail. Excludes token cleanup. The red threshold marks 100 failures/hour.

spec.title: Delivery failures (1h)
spec.description: Real delivery failures in the last hour, excluding token cleanup (HTTP 404/410 and APNS dead-token errors).

spec.title: Token cleanups (1h)
spec.description: Token invalidations in the last hour. These are not errors: the user uninstalled the app or the token expired, and we should stop sending. APNS 410, FCM 404, plus APNS dead-token error reasons.

spec.expr:
(sum(increase(notification_failures_total{provider=~"$provider", reason=~"${cleanup_reasons}"}[1h])) or vector(0))
+
(sum(increase(notification_failures_total{provider=~"$provider", reason!~"${cleanup_reasons}", details=~"${dead_token_details}"}[1h])) or vector(0))

spec.title: Failure ratio by provider (5m)
spec.description: Real failures as a percentage of total send attempts per provider, over a 5-minute window. A small global ratio can mask a single dead provider, so this is split per provider. The query joins failure and success counters via label_replace because the success counters lack a provider label.

spec.expr:
100 * (sum by (provider) (rate(notification_failures_total{provider=~"$provider", reason!~"${cleanup_reasons}", details!~"${dead_token_details}"}[5m])))
  /
  clamp_min(
    sum by (provider) (rate(notification_failures_total{provider=~"$provider", reason!~"${cleanup_reasons}", details!~"${dead_token_details}"}[5m]))
    +
    sum by (provider) (
      label_replace(rate(direct_notifications_total[5m]), "provider", "APNS", "", "")
      or
      label_replace(rate(fcm_notifications_total[5m]), "provider", "FCM", "", "")
      or
      label_replace(rate(ubports_notifications_total[5m]), "provider", "UBports", "", "")
      or
      label_replace(rate(webpush_notifications_total[5m]), "provider", "WebPush", "", "")
    ),
    0.0001
  )

spec.title: Config errors (1h)
spec.description: Provider configuration failures in the last hour: APNS no_certificate, FCM no_api_key / api_key_fetch, WebPush no_vapid_key. Any non-zero value means an entire provider channel is down.

spec.title: OpenPGP decryption failures (1d)
spec.description: Trend of OpenPGP token decryption failures, in 1-day buckets. A sustained increase may indicate a key rotation issue or misconfiguration.

spec.title: Token invalidations: cleanup, not failures
spec.description: Routine token invalidations per hour, grouped by provider, reason, and detail. Not real delivery failures: they indicate uninstalls or expired tokens. Useful for spotting uninstall waves.

spec.title: APNS: failures by reason and detail
spec.description: Real APNS failures over the selected time range, broken down by reason and APNS error detail. Excludes token cleanup and dead-token errors.

spec.title: FCM: failures by reason
spec.description: Real FCM failures over the selected time range, broken down by reason. Excludes token cleanup. FCM does not populate the details label.

spec.title: Failures by provider (7d trend)
spec.description: Last 7 days of real delivery failures per provider, in hourly buckets. This panel uses a fixed 7-day range regardless of the dashboard time picker.

spec.title: OpenPGP decrypt fails
spec.description: OpenPGP token decryption failures over the selected time range. Device tokens are encrypted with OpenPGP for privacy; on decryption failure the gateway returns HTTP 410 Gone so the email server removes the token.

spec.title: Notifications: Failures
